name: Phenglutarimide
summary: Phenglutarimide (brand names Aturbal and Aturbane) is an anticholinergic used as an antiparkinsonian agent.

pharmacology.text: Phenglutarimide (brand names Aturbal and Aturbane) is an anticholinergic used as an antiparkinsonian agent.

uses.text: Phenglutarimide (brand names Aturbal and Aturbane) is an anticholinergic used as an antiparkinsonian agent.

summaryZh: 芬格魯胺是一種有機化合物，化學式為C17H24N2O2，可用作抗膽鹼劑。

sideEffects.en: Anticholinergic drugs cause dry mouth, blurred vision, constipation and difficulty passing urine, and in older people they can cause confusion and memory problems.
sideEffects.zh: 抗膽鹼藥物會造成口乾、視力模糊、便祕與排尿困難，在年長者可能造成意識混亂與記憶問題。
sideEffects.zhHans: 抗胆碱药物会造成口干、视力模糊、便秘与排尿困难，在年长者可能造成意识混乱与记忆问题。

fact.en: It is chemically related to glutethimide, a sedative, but the same ring system here gives an anticholinergic drug used for Parkinson's disease instead.
fact.zh: 它的化學結構與鎮靜劑格魯米特相關，但同樣的環系在這裡卻形成一種抗膽鹼藥物，用於帕金森氏症。
fact.zhHans: 它的化学结构与镇静剂格鲁米特相关，但同样的环系在这里却形成一种抗胆碱药物，用于帕金森氏症。
